records.quote: The major differences between them are as follows: (1) Wu et al. [19] and Buschow [16] reported the congruent melting point of the Co17 Er2 compound is about 1442 ◦ C and 1355 ◦ C, respectively; (2) Wu et al. observed that the Co3 Er4 phase is metastable phase [19], while Buschow included the Co3 Er4 phase in the stable phase diagram [16]; (3) Wu et al. identified that the phase near 64 at.% Er is the Co9 Er16 phase [19], rather than the Co7 Er12 phase by Buschow [16].
